one_line: Expansion-era Mysore maharaja who built a more formal, fiscally strong state while ruling from Srirangapatna and Mysore.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium height, solid but not bulky build with a poised, courtly bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm wheat-brown complexion, neatly groomed medium moustache tapering at the ends, slight stubble on the chin, straight nose, thoughtful dark eyes with a steady gaze; default expression is composed and serious with a hint of calculation, as if weighing policy and consequence.
appearance.hair: Black hair pulled back into a tight low bun at the back of the head, mostly hidden beneath a deep maroon Mysore-style turban (peta) wrapped flat and layered, with a narrow golden band around its base and a single small white feather tucked on the left.
appearance.costume: He wears a long cream-coloured silk angarkha-style robe (south Indian court robe) crossing right over left and tied at the side with thin cords, its edges finely piped in gold; over this sits a rich deep green silk waistcoat-like outer coat (sleeveless, hip-length) with subtle woven floral motifs in a slightly darker green and a narrow gold border, leaving the angarkha sleeves fully visible; around his waist is a broad saffron silk waistband (kamarband) wrapped twice and knotted at the left, with the tail neatly tucked; his lower garment is a white cotton dhoti, pleated in front, wrapped to the ankles with a thin gold stripe near the hem, worn in a Mysore court drape; he has simple but elegant brown leather mojari-style shoes with slightly upturned toes; jewellery is restrained yet royal—a single medium-length gold necklace with small beads, a pair of modest gold stud earrings, and a narrow gold bangle on his right wrist; over one shoulder (usually the left) lies a lightweight off-white muslin shawl with a thin green border, hinting at his Srivaishnava and courtly refinement.
appearance.signature: A polished steel talwar with a gently curving blade and a gold-hilted Indo-Muslim style grip, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, worn tucked into his saffron waistband on his left side, often resting under his right hand as if symbolising both rule and restraint.

ref_desc: Chikka Devaraja Wodeyar is a wheat-brown, oval-faced Mysore king in a cream angarkha, deep green sleeveless coat, saffron waistband, white dhoti, maroon peta with gold band and feather, wearing simple gold jewellery and brown mojari shoes, carrying a gold-hilted steel talwar in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Chikka Devaraja Wodeyar: a late-30s Mysore maharaja with a wheat-brown oval face, neat tapered moustache and thoughtful dark eyes, hair in a low bun under a deep maroon Mysore peta wrapped flat with a narrow golden band and a single small white feather on the left. He wears a long cream silk angarkha-style robe crossing right over left with fine gold piping, under a rich deep green sleeveless silk outer coat with subtle woven floral motifs and a narrow gold border, plus a broad saffron silk waistband wrapped twice and knotted at the left. His white cotton dhoti is pleated, ankle-length, with a thin gold stripe near the hem, and he has simple brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes. Show a lightweight off-white muslin shawl with a thin green border over his left shoulder, a single medium-length gold bead necklace, modest gold stud earrings, and a narrow gold bangle on his right wrist. At his left side, tucked into the saffron waistband, is a polished steel talwar with a gently curving blade and a gold hilt in Indo-Muslim style, in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, his right hand often resting near the hilt. Use a palette dominated by deep green, cream, saffron, maroon, and white, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show consistent face, turban, garments, and weapon details.
